endorsements.label: REW-sploit: dissect payloads with ease
endorsements.description: Need help in analyzing Windows shellcode or attack coming from **Metasploit Framework** or **Cobalt Strike** (or may be also other malicious or obfuscated code)? Do you need to automate tasks with simple scripting? Do you want help to decrypt **MSF** generated traffic by extracting keys from payloads? ABSTRACT REW-sploit do some heavy lifting and provide you an interface to analyze Windows based code (EXE, DLL or shellcode) and give you some useful insight!
